result: pass for UTM QEMU installer, persistence and uninstrumented ToTheFront setup/artillery
environment: UTM bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, one vCPU, NEC USB CD and input with VirtIO recovery input, 1 GiB
checks: ISO source bundle and packed installer hashes matched their build inputs.
EFI partition source bundle and the source-volume Human.ZC were individually read back and matched the intended fixed files.
Host sparse installer payload round trip matched the complete raw source disk.
Live USB-CD boot, unconfirmed-install protection, full installer read-back and byte-for-byte installed disk comparison passed.
Disk-only boot generated Stadium data, persisted a test source, and reloaded and executed it after a second disk-only boot.
An uninstrumented ToTheFront game on a disposable clone of the packaged disk accepted both player choices, plotted an artillery order, advanced a phase and returned to a terminal.

pi_candidate.validation: Pi native/recovery ELF and boot-chain validation passed with 1039 bundled source modules. No microSD was written.

limitations: The direct-fire regression used an instrumented controlled-target fixture, as described in tothefront-candidate-qemu-2026-11-09.json; the uninstrumented game check did not exercise direct fire.
No live UTM UI retest or physical Pi test of this exact payload.
No claim that all programs, complete ToTheFront gameplay, or Pi writable storage work.
Earlier normal ISO and disk were preserved.
